For 2025, the Social Security tax requires employers and employees to each contribute 6.2% of wages up to $176,100.

The Medicare tax requires employers and employees to each contribute 1.45% of all wages.

See the IRS webpage for details, like maximum thresholds.

### FUTA

Like the state, the federal government also has an unemployment tax, called FUTA, which is paid by employers.

FUTA is an annual tax an employer pays on the first $7,000 of each employee’s wages. [...] For employees that earn over $200,000 per year, 0.9% of earnings will need to be withheld for the Additional Medicare tax.

Whether or not your employee owes this tax may depend on their filing status.

### Paying federal taxes

How often you’ll pay federal payroll taxes depends on how much you owe. [...] The FUTA rate is subject to annual updates by the IRS. The FUTA rate is generally 6.0%, but many employers are able to pay less due to tax credits.

Most employers will pay this tax annually with Form 940. But larger employers with more than $500 in tax due will have to pay quarterly.
